## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Repository or CI maintenance

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] Site checks from `site/` when site files changed

If a check was not run, explain why. Do not report CI as green unless it completed.

## Truthfulness checklist

- [ ] No live Stripe keys, tokens, customer data, or private specifications were added.
- [ ] Findings are described as evidence for review, not proof of runtime behavior.
- [ ] Unsupported changes remain `needs_human`; missing verification remains `could_not_run`.
- [ ] Commands and limits match `README.md` and the site.
- [ ] No generated reports, logs, or `.env` files were committed.
